prompt: The camera tilts slowly upward. The enormous steel crane straddling the motorway lifts its right leg, one rigid steel column, clear off the road and swings it forward over the jammed cars in one slow heavy step, sparks and grit showering down from the joint, the people between the cars ducking and running. The leg stays straight and solid. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so anything moving fast smears with natural motion blur. One continuous shot, no cuts.
why: Kai 9 Nov: iterate until clean. 04 r1: a beam bent like rubber and no stride. Ask for one rigid leg, one step.
